# JumpEffect

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** JumpEffect

## What it does

JumpEffect renders a glowing effect on the ground beneath your feet each time you jump. It expands outward and fades away over a short time, adding a stylish visual flourish to your movement without affecting gameplay in any way.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/jumpeffect). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
